settings.title: Hold it close
settings.text: Rest your pal on your lap or chest and wrap your arms around it. The weight settles evenly, like a long, steady hug.

settings.title: Feel the weight
settings.text: Gentle, even pressure is the same idea behind weighted blankets, in a form that is easy to carry from room to room.

settings.title: Settle in
settings.text: Make it part of your wind-down routine, your reading chair or your desk. Comfort that is always within reach.
Holding something soft and heavy feels calming to a lot of people. Here is what the research says, and what it doesn't.

settings.title: Deep pressure
settings.text: Firm, even pressure spread across the body is called deep pressure stimulation. Occupational therapists have used it for decades, and studies suggest it can shift the nervous system toward its slower, "rest and digest" mode.

settings.title: What studies found
settings.text: A 2020 review in the American Journal of Occupational Therapy concluded weighted blankets may be a reasonable tool for reducing anxiety. In a Swedish trial the same year, 120 adults with insomnia and conditions including generalised anxiety used a weighted or light blanket for four weeks. The weighted group reported less daytime anxiety.

settings.title: The honest part
settings.text: Those studies used blankets, much heavier than a plush, and the research is still small. Weighted plushies haven't been studied directly yet. Think of your pal as a comfort tool, like a warm drink or a slow breath, not a treatment.

settings.title: Slow breathing.
settings.text: Rest it on your chest and let it rise and fall as you breathe out longer than you breathe in.

settings.title: Busy hands, busy mind.
settings.text: Keep it on your lap while you study, work or scroll.

settings.title: Winding down.
settings.text: Make it part of your bedtime routine so your body learns the cue.

settings.title: On the go.
settings.text: Bring it on flights, long drives or to appointments that make you nervous.

settings.title: Comforting
settings.text: A weighted hug for evenings, travel days and everything in between.
